description.value:
Implant that increases the brain's capacity to store and process information related to Netrunning.

Neuralware. Requires Neuroport Cyberdeck Port.

Each installation contains a Hardware-only Option Slot for Cyberdeck Hardware.

All Hardware installed in a user's Ex-Disks are considered to be installed in any Cyberdeck installed in a user's Neuroport Cyberdeck Port.

A user with two or more Ex-Disk installations gains one additional NET Action every turn while physically connected to an Access Point manually via their Personal Link.
